source: ClawsGO Science research taxonomy (re-written) + AI-science pipeline survey

summary.zh: 筛出重要论文、逐篇精读，交付结构化综述与完整引用。
summary.en: Shortlist the papers that matter, read them, deliver a structured review with full citations.

prompt.zh: 围绕「{topic}」写一篇结构化文献综述：检索近三年的重要论文并筛选精读，按研究方向归类梳理脉络，产出代表工作对比表、开放问题清单与完整引用。先做一次反例检索，不要只找支持性证据。
prompt.en: Write a structured literature review on "{topic}": find and closely read the important papers of the last three years, organise them by research direction, and deliver a comparison table, an open-questions list and a full bibliography. Run one disconfirming search first; do not only collect supporting evidence.

gateHints.survey: 至少 8 个来源，其中 2 个一手；每次引用可解析
gateHints.write: 稿件里的数字与引用必须来自台账

summary.zh: 检索注册库，把设计、终点与结果整理成一张对比表。
summary.en: Search trial registries and put design, endpoints and results into one comparison table.

prompt.zh: 在 ClinicalTrials.gov 检索近五年针对「{topic}」的 III 期临床试验，把设计、样本量、主要终点、结果与不良事件整理成结构化对比表，附一页概览摘要，并标注每条信息的注册号与检索日期。
prompt.en: Search ClinicalTrials.gov for phase III trials on "{topic}" from the last five years, build a structured comparison table (design, sample size, primary endpoint, results, adverse events), add a one-page summary, and record the registry id and retrieval date for every row.

gateHints.survey: 每个试验一条来源，带注册号
gateHints.analyze: 结果数字必须可追到注册记录

summary.zh: 从清洗到多模型对比与调参，交付可复现的评测报告。
summary.en: From cleaning to multi-model comparison, deliver a reproducible evaluation report.

prompt.zh: 在「{data}」上完成端到端建模：数据清洗与特征工程、至少三种算法的对比、调参与固定种子的交叉验证，产出模型对比表（含置信区间）、失败案例与一份面向非技术读者的结论报告。所有运行命令与指标写进台账。
prompt.en: Build an end-to-end model on "{data}": cleaning and feature engineering, at least three algorithms, tuning and seed-fixed cross-validation. Deliver a comparison table with confidence intervals, failure cases and a non-technical summary. Record every run command and metric in the ledger.

gateHints.execute: 每个成功运行都有种子与指标

summary.zh: 用公开数据做趋势、区域对比与统计检验。
summary.en: Use public data for trends, regional comparison and statistical tests.

prompt.zh: 用 WHO 与世界银行的公开数据，分析「{topic}」近 20 年的趋势：获取并清洗数据、做分区域对比与统计检验（说明检验前提）、绘制趋势图，最后写成一份带图表的分析报告。记录数据版本与下载日期。
prompt.en: Using WHO and World Bank public data, analyse the last 20 years of "{topic}": acquire and clean the data, compare regions, run statistical tests (state their assumptions), draw trend figures, and write an analysis report with figures. Record the data version and download date.

gateHints.analyze: 检验前提与不确定性写清楚

summary.zh: 精读论文，产出幻灯片与逐页讲稿。
summary.en: Read the paper closely and deliver slides with speaker notes.

prompt.zh: 把「{paper}」讲成一场 15 分钟的组会汇报：精读论文，产出结构清晰的幻灯片（研究问题、方法、关键实验、局限与后续工作），为每页配讲稿，用 LaTeX Beamer 制作，学术风格。引用原文页码，不要改写实验数字。
prompt.en: Turn "{paper}" into a 15-minute group meeting talk: read it closely, produce clear slides (question, method, key experiments, limitations, follow-up) with speaker notes, built with LaTeX Beamer in an academic style. Cite page numbers; never rewrite the experimental numbers.

summary.zh: 从多份访谈中提炼主题、证据片段与机会点。
summary.en: Extract themes, evidence quotes and opportunities from interviews.

prompt.zh: 围绕「{topic}」生成 8 份风格各异的模拟访谈记录（覆盖不同角色与场景），再做结构化归纳：提炼主题并聚类、为每个主题标注支撑原文片段、汇总成主题 × 证据 × 机会点的洞察报告，另出一页高管摘要。明确标注这是模拟数据。
prompt.en: Generate eight varied simulated interviews about "{topic}" (different roles and scenarios), then synthesise: cluster themes, attach supporting quotes, deliver an insight report (theme × evidence × opportunity) plus a one-page executive summary. State clearly that the interviews are simulated.

gateHints.analyze: 每个主题至少两条原文证据

summary.zh: 同一数据集横向对比三个库，给出可复现的选型结论。
summary.en: Benchmark three libraries on one dataset and give a reproducible recommendation.

prompt.zh: 对「{libs}」做选型评测：在同一个数据集上各实现三种常用图表，编写基准脚本比较渲染性能与代码量，结合文档质量与社区生态，产出带示例图与数据支撑的评测报告。记录版本号、硬件与运行次数。
prompt.en: Evaluate "{libs}": implement three common charts on one dataset with each library, benchmark rendering time and code size, assess documentation and community, and deliver a report with example figures and data. Record versions, hardware and repetitions.

gateHints.analyze: 区分测量噪声与真实差异

summary.zh: 实现回测框架，输出净值曲线与风险指标。
summary.en: Build a backtest and report equity curve plus risk metrics.

prompt.zh: 实现「{strategy}」的回测：写一个可复现的回测框架，用公开历史行情数据运行近十年回测，做参数敏感性分析，产出净值曲线图与风险指标（最大回撤、夏普、换手、交易成本）。明确声明不构成投资建议。
prompt.en: Backtest "{strategy}": build a reproducible framework, run ten years of public market data, do a parameter sensitivity analysis, and report the equity curve and risk metrics (max drawdown, Sharpe, turnover, costs). State clearly that this is not investment advice.

gateHints.design: 先定样本外与停止规则
gateHints.analyze: 防止过拟合，报告样本外

summary.zh: 生成可预览的静态学术主页，先占位后替换。
summary.en: Generate a previewable static academic homepage with placeholders first.

prompt.zh: 为「{name}」搭建个人学术主页：静态站点，包含首页（研究方向简介）、论文列表页（按年份分组）与简历页；先用占位内容生成可预览的完整源码，说明替换点，确认样式后再换真实信息。
prompt.en: Build an academic homepage for "{name}": a static site with a home page (research intro), a publications page grouped by year and a CV page. Generate complete previewable source with placeholders, document the replacement points, and only then swap in real information.

gateHints.write: 占位内容必须显式标注

summary.zh: 财报、竞争、新闻交叉验证，输出风险清单与估值框架。
summary.en: Cross-check filings, competition and news; deliver risks and a valuation frame.

prompt.zh: 对「{company}」做一次深度尽调：梳理最近四个季度财报要点、行业格局与主要竞品动态、近期重大新闻并交叉验证，产出一份投研报告，包含业务分析、风险清单与估值框架（DCF 思路即可，标注关键假设与数据日期）。
prompt.en: Do due diligence on "{company}": cover the last four quarters of filings, industry structure and competitors, recent material news with cross-checking, and deliver an investment memo with business analysis, a risk list and a valuation frame (DCF outline is enough, with key assumptions and data dates).

gateHints.survey: 一手财报优先于二手新闻

title.zh: 工业 DOE 与测量系统

summary.zh: 先证明测量系统可靠，再用 DOE 找因子与确认运行。
summary.en: Validate the measurement system first, then use DOE for factors and a confirmation run.

prompt.zh: 研究「{topic}」的工艺窗口：先写系统边界、运行工况与安全相关功能，完成量具 R&R / 偏倚 / 线性 / 稳定性与校准溯源；再做因子实验（因子、水平、重复、随机化、区组），预先写接受准则，分析主效应/交互与测量不确定度，最后在新批次上做确认运行并给出 Cp/Cpk、追溯链与生产监测计划。
prompt.en: Study the process window for "{topic}": define the system boundary, operating context and safety-related functions; complete gauge R&R / bias / linearity / stability and calibration traceability; then run a factorial experiment (factors, levels, replicates, randomisation, blocking) with pre-specified acceptance criteria, analyse main effects/interactions and measurement uncertainty, and finish with a confirmation run on a new batch plus Cp/Cpk, traceability and a production monitoring plan.

gateHints.design: 接受准则与随机化先定

summary.zh: 用 rubric 拆解目标论文，从零复现主结果并解释差异。
summary.en: Decompose a target paper with a rubric, reproduce the main result and explain gaps.

prompt.zh: 复现「{paper}」的主结果：先把论文拆成可评分的 rubric（环境、数据、方法、指标、容差），从零搭环境跑通，记录每个差异并判断是实现问题还是论文问题。不要用作者代码直接交差；如果用了，必须单独标注。
prompt.en: Replicate the main result of "{paper}": first decompose the paper into a scoring rubric (environment, data, method, metric, tolerance), build the environment from scratch, record every discrepancy and judge whether it is an implementation or a paper issue. Do not pass off the authors' code as your own; if used, label it explicitly.

summary.zh: 为一个已有结论设计消融组与负对照，检验它是否只是噪声。
summary.en: Design ablations and negative controls for an existing claim to test whether it is noise.

prompt.zh: 针对「{claim}」设计一组消融与负对照：列出每一个可能造成该结果的替代解释，为每个解释设计一个能证伪它的实验；至少包含一个标签置换/随机化负对照与一个空模型基线。先写预注册（指标、样本量、停止规则、种子），再跑。
prompt.en: Design ablations and negative controls for "{claim}": list every alternative explanation, design an experiment that would falsify each, and include at least one label-permutation/randomisation control and one null baseline. Write the pre-registration (metric, n, stopping rule, seed) before running.

gateHints.design: 每个替代解释对应一个对照

summary.zh: 以红队视角找出能让结论不成立的最强反驳。
summary.en: Red-team the work and find the strongest objection that would break the conclusion.

prompt.zh: 对「{target}」做一次对抗评审：假设你是最挑剔的审稿人，找出能让核心结论不成立的最强反驳（统计、对照、数据泄漏、外部效度、引用错误），按阻断/重要/次要分级，并给出可执行的修复建议。不要客气，也不要为了反对而反对。
prompt.en: Adversarially review "{target}": act as the harshest referee, find the strongest objections that would break the core conclusion (statistics, controls, leakage, external validity, citation errors), grade them blocking/major/minor, and give actionable fixes. Do not be polite for its own sake, and do not object for the sake of objecting.

gateHints.review: 至少一条阻断级反驳或明确说明没有
